dns.public_api: gethostbyname/gethostbyname_addrtype return one address or NULL callback; no cancellation, flush, detailed error or TTL result API
dns.lifetime: dns_init does not flush initialized tables; dns_setserver does not clear cache or cancel requests
dns.cache: DNS_STATE_DONE TTL decremented per dns_tmr invocation; timeout overload skips missed intervals
dns.packet_findings: See actual 12 observations in audit.json; test overrides DNS only in private include directory

dhcp.capabilities: dhcp_start, renew, network_changed_link_up, release_and_stop, cleanup; DHCP and ACD production flags disabled
dhcp.timers: default fine 500ms and coarse 60s; offered finite lease rounds to coarse ticks; absolute-deadline adaptation required
dhcp.identity: UDP PCB connects to source port67; application parser checks BOOTREPLY/chaddr/XID; further option/state audit required
dhcp.randomness: DHCP_CREATE_RAND_XID defaults1 and uses LWIP_RAND; runtime entropy failure must suppress transmission
dhcp.integration: DHCP updates netif address and optional global DNS servers; controller policy/atomic config epoch required

primary_references.scope: response matching and unpredictable ID/source port
